# Pre-run check Checklist: the check itself and the non-regression of recognition

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the written requirements (spec, plan, tasks) of spec 010: the level verdicts and their threshold, blocking, the tuning question, what a start is, and the non-regression of the recognition. Standard depth, for the product owner as reviewer.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command from the spec, the plan and the tasks.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## The level verdicts and their threshold

- [ ] CHK001 Is "the 300 ms after a strum" defined precisely enough to be measured the same way twice (what counts as the attack, from which sample the 300 ms start)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan R2]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the threshold of 0.5 % stated with its basis (worst clean window 0.23 %, owner's clipped takes) and is it clear that it is a provisional constant and not a learner setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan R1]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the share defined as a share of samples at the clip level, and is the clip level itself (0.99 of full scale, the existing setting) written in the spec and not only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are "too weak" and "too loud" defined with numbers or with a reference to the existing levels (-40 dBFS, -6 dBFS) in the spec itself, not only in the plan? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Plan R3]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it stated what a strum is when the learner plays one note or two (not a chord), and whether the check still judges the level? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the case of the ring of an earlier note counted as clipping addressed in the requirements, not only in the plan risks? [Coverage, Plan Risks]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the verdicts mutually exclusive and ordered (what is reported when a signal both clips and is too loud, or clips and is weak on average)? [Ambiguity, Plan R3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "no strum" state bounded in time (how long the window keeps asking, when *Continue anyway* appears) with one number used consistently in the spec, the plan and the tasks? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases, Tasks T015, T024]
- [ ] CHK009 Does SC-001 say how many of the owner's takes must be caught and on which gain, and is that figure consistent with the 0.5 % threshold and with the figures of the data (19 of 21)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001]

## Blocking and "Continue anyway"

- [ ] CHK010 Is it clear which verdicts block and which only inform (clipping, too weak, too loud, no strum), in one place of the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "this start only" defined (what counts as the same start after *Check again*, after the tuner, after a cancel)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the learner's options after a blocked start fully listed (check again, continue anyway, cancel) with what each leads to? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the advice given with a bad level specific enough (which control, which direction) and is it clear it reuses the existing guidance texts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Plan R7]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the requirement that the application never changes the gain by itself written for the check as well as for the old level panel? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## The tuning question and the tuner

- [ ] CHK015 Is the tuning question a statement of what the learner says ("in tune") and not a claim the application verifies, and is that visible in the wording requirements? [Clarity, Constitution XIII, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the way back from the tuner specified for every way the tuner can end (closed by the learner, closed by the application, left open and the learner starts again)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it defined what "the same choices" means after the tuner (mode, track, tempo, tolerance) and that none is lost? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the order of the two checks stated (tuning first or strum first) and does the spec, the plan and the tasks agree on it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan R4, Tasks T018-T021]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the case of a learner with no instrument connected or no input chosen defined for the start window (which message, which buttons)? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## What a start is

- [ ] CHK020 Is the list of starts covered complete and unambiguous (Start button, quick start, transport-bar Arcade button, any menu or keyboard shortcut that starts a mode)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Plan R4]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it written in the spec, and not only in the plan, which restarts do **not** ask again (Restart, play again, from a measure, restart after a failed start) and why? [Gap, Plan R4]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the case of a restart after a long pause or after the input changed (another device, another gain) addressed, or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Plan R4]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it stated what happens to a start requested while the start window or a run is already open? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the change to the Arcade transport-bar button (it no longer starts at once) stated as a requirement, with the consequence for the one-click promise of spec 003? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Plan R4]

## Time and the learner's effort

- [ ] CHK025 Is "one answer and at most 5 seconds" measurable (from which moment to which moment, under which conditions) and does it include the strum itself? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the time requirement consistent with a strum that has to wait for the learner (the 5 seconds cannot include the learner's own delay)? [Conflict, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK027 Is there a requirement for the learner who knows what they are doing (fewer steps) beyond *Continue anyway*, or is the absence of one a decision recorded in the spec? [Gap, Spec Story 3]

## Texts, platforms, assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Are the texts required in the three languages with the rule that the verdict lines say what was measured and never that the chord is wrong? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Constitution XIII]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the platform limits stated (the advice names the macOS input volume, Windows and Linux not validated) in the spec and not only in the plan? [Coverage, Spec Assumptions, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the assumptions about the evidence validated or marked as unvalidated (the owner's takes labelled by a transcription tool, not by the owner; one guitar, one interface)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## The non-regression of the recognition

- [ ] CHK031 Does FR-012 name the kinds of event that must be covered (note, each technique, chord) and say what "covered" means (a test with recorded audio, with synthetic audio)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the kinds with no recorded-audio test (hammer-on, pull-off, palm mute, tapping, tremolo picking) acknowledged in the spec as a known gap rather than only in the research and the tasks? [Gap, Plan R8, Tasks T028]
- [ ] CHK033 Is "equal or better" defined for each kind of figure (counts, percentages, delays, false acceptances) with the direction of better for each? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK034 Is it clear which figures are recorded before the change, where, and that no code is committed before them (an ordering requirement in the tasks, not only a habit)? [Completeness, Plan P0, Tasks T001-T005]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the treatment of a suite that cannot run (data absent, no display) written (reported as skipped with a reason, never as passed)? [Edge Case, Tasks T002-T003, Constitution XII]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the owner's takes defined as a baseline with a recorded minimum and not as a target of 100 %, and is it written why the first version of that test fails today? [Clarity, Tasks T004, T029]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the limited trust of the owner's labels (a transcription tool, harmonics possible, the D chord) stated where the figures are used, so that no figure is read as a verified fact? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Plan R9]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the requirement that the check does not change any judgement (SC-005) backed by a stated method (the same recorded run with and without) that covers all three modes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Tasks T026]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the separation from the recognition work of spec 004 T007 (the D chord, chords with a note missing) stated in the scope so that a worse figure there cannot block this feature unjustly? [Consistency, Spec Out of scope, Plan R9]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the acceptance for the owner (SC-006) stated as observable on the built application with the interface at the gain that clipped, and does it say what the owner must see for each of the two gains? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Tasks T034]

## Notes

- Reviewer: tick an item when the written requirement is satisfactory; an item you cannot tick becomes a point for `/speckit-clarify` or a correction before `/speckit-implement`.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checkbox state but does not modify the markers.
